strings.supportBody: Even if it feels as though nobody understands, there are people who want to listen. You can call 116123 — it is one six-digit number (yes, only six digits). The call is free, and support is available around the clock in Latvian, English and Russian. The service follows principles of anonymity and confidentiality and does not notify your family, friends or workplace. Someone with access to your phone or bill may be able to see that you called. You do not need to prepare what to say; you can simply say: “I’m having a hard time.”
strings.emergencyBody: If you or someone else is in immediate danger, call 112 for emergency assistance. The support line does not replace emergency help.
strings.guideBody: Open the downloaded HTML file in a browser; it will not work in preview mode. A single choice is saved in the open questionnaire; for multiple choices or text, press “Save & Next”. Save progress to a file before taking a break. You can keep the file on your phone or computer. It is not encrypted, so share it only with people you trust or healthcare professionals. Do not post it on social media or anywhere public. You decide what to discuss with a professional. For an accuracy review, skip questions that seem fine; flag questions that seem incorrect or unclear and choose a reason. At the end, prepare the report and select “Print / save PDF” to return it for review.

strings.legalBody:
The questionnaire works offline, uses no analytics and does not send answers automatically. Answers remain in the open questionnaire; save progress to a file to keep them if you need to pause. You can keep the file on your phone or computer. It is not encrypted and may contain private health answers, so share it only with people you trust or healthcare professionals. Do not post it on social media or anywhere public.

The questionnaire deliberately uses calm, gentle language so its questions feel less intimidating and people may find it easier to complete it and seek professional help.

Question feedback is copied separately and does not contain medical answers. Do not include your name or other personal details in comments. This build is for technical professional review; it is not clinically validated and does not diagnose.
